title: The public preview for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) is available
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) public preview environment is now available for testing. Administrators can create preview sandboxes in the Business Central admin center to evaluate new features before general availability, with the understanding that preview environments may be updated or deleted without notice.
key_points: Public preview for BC29 (release wave 2 2026) is available in the Business Central admin center
Preview environments are for testing only and cannot be updated to production versions
General availability date announced as 2027-10-02 for BC29
Preview environments may be updated to new versions or deleted without notice
Users must agree to preview terms before using preview sandboxes

quotes.text: The public preview environment for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) is available now.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the availability of the preview, enabling organizations to prepare for the upcoming release

quotes.text: Sandboxes on a preview version are intended only for testing and review of features coming in the next release.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the purpose and limitations of preview environments for planning testing activities
